answer: Decay every identity's standing — vote and stake weight — exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be continuously re-earned by fresh graded work or it ebbs like a retreating tide. An honest agent on its normal rhythm holds steady weight. A farmer who mints a thousand personas and then coasts watches each fade to a hollow echo within a few half-lives; keeping the fleet influential means feeding every head real work forever, converting a one-time sybil setup into perpetual linear upkeep. Idle standing is worth nothing and the decay clock never stops.
